title: Delete stays enabled for an entry whose locations only received the number
custom_preconds: • A Part Library entry listed at two locations on its detail page but with no part stocked there (the locations only received the number), e.g. 3058653.
custom_steps:
1. Open the entry and click the pencil.
  2. Look at Delete; do not confirm a delete unless the entry is a throwaway.
  3. Open the Edit Library Part window of an entry stocked at one location for comparison.
custom_expected:
Step 2:

  • Delete is enabled (the entry is not in use; deletable true).

Step 3:

  • Delete is disabled with "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first."
